summary.text: Jeffrey Perez is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Tammy West.

A bankruptcy lawyer who earned his law degree from Oklahoma City University in 2026, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a first-generation college graduate and a District 84 resident for more than a decade.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Perez graduated from Putnam City West High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2023 and a law degree from the Oklahoma City University School of Law in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in a single-parent household and graduated from public schools in the district he is seeking to represent.
In the survey, Perez said he decided to run after seeing Oklahoma fall behind in areas including education, criminal justice and domestic violence prevention.
He said he supports teachers, smaller classes and school funding, and opposes expanding private school vouchers, noting that the district has only one K-8 private school.
